title: Bumper Ball
description:
I wanted to make a classic brick break type game (I loved DX-BALL 2 as a kid), but with **physics** like a pinball machine. That lead to Bumper Ball—you get a heavy chrome ball, a bumper paddle to throw it around with, and a series of levels full of round pegs to break!
